response.sql: WITH telescope_counts AS (SELECT telescref, COUNT(*) AS signal_count FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(signal_count) AS total_count FROM telescope_counts) SELECT c.telescref, c.signal_count, 1.0 * c.signal_count / t.total_count AS signal_share FROM telescope_counts AS c LEFT JOIN totals AS t ON 1 = 1 WHERE t.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY signal_share IS NULL, signal_share DESC LIMIT 10;
